schema.title: critique.json — output of scope-critic / premortem-critic (session A); goes to the owner unfiltered

rubric.description: scope-critic: value | cheapest-version | scope-creep | dependency. premortem-critic: data-loss | migration | authz | ops | timing | concurrency

weight.description: 5 = would make the story wrong or harmful; 1 = nice to know

evidence.description: reference to capability-report / story text; opinions without evidence get weight ≤ 2

addresses_rejected_alternative.description: if the objection repeats a rejected alternative, name it — the owner already decided

reply_round.description: 1 = initial critique, 2 = single reply after the owner's response; no further rounds
